scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
Hmm...?
I, Titicupe, esteemed manager of the Toy Factory and genius inventor, has done it again! I've just created the world's most sophisticated vending machine!
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
嗯...？
我，蒂蒂库佩，玩具工厂的尊贵经理兼天才发明家，又做到了！我刚刚发明了世界上最精密的自动售货机！

scripts.text: Talk to him about the Vending Machine
scripts.translation: 和他聊聊自动售货机

scripts.text: Items in the Vending Machine
scripts.translation: 自动售货机里的物品

scripts.text: Stop talking
scripts.translation: 别说了

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
Can you see the little snowman to the left side of me? Can you? If you look at his mouth closely, you'll see that it's been built quite largely. You might say, a bit too large for normal purposes...
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
你能看到我左边的小雪人吗？能吗？如果你仔细看它的嘴巴，你会发现它被造得相当大。可以说，对于普通用途来说，有点太大了...

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
You see, that snowman is actually an amazing vending machine that I invented out of my blood, sweat, tears and snow.
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
你看，那个雪人其实是我用血、汗、泪和雪发明的一台神奇的自动售货机。

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
You can put all sorts of things inside its mouth, and if you insert the right items, you'll get some hats in return...
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
你可以往它的嘴巴里放入各种各样的东西，如果你投入正确的物品，就会得到一些帽子作为回报...

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
Fashionable hats that you've always dreamed of wearing...! Bwahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
那些你一直梦想戴上的时尚帽子...！哇哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
Oh, this creation of mine is so magnificent!
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
哦，我的这个发明真是太宏伟了！

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
And the headgears--! I... I can't contain myself!
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
还有那些头饰——！我...我简直无法抑制内心的激动！

scripts.text: ^3355FFToy factory manager Titicupe jumps and convulses with joy. Clearly he's insane, but it may be possible that he may be brilliant.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF玩具工厂经理蒂蒂库佩高兴得跳起来，浑身抽搐。他显然疯了，但也可能他是个天才。^000000

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
Oh right! You need to know what kind of items to put into the Vending Machine to get what you want, yes? Go ahead... Ask me~
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
对了！你需要知道往自动售货机里放什么物品才能得到你想要的东西，对吧？尽管问吧~

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
Ask me anytime. Those kinds of questions are no problem for geniuses like me!
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
随时问我。这种问题对我来说这种天才来说根本不是问题！

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
So happy!!
I'm a genius~!
Ho ho ho
Ho ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
太开心了！！
我是天才~！
呵呵呵
呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
Sometimes, I can't believe how magnificent this invention of mine is...!
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]
有时候，我都无法相信我的这项发明有多伟大...！

scripts.text:
[Titicupe]
I...
I love you
Mister Snowman
Vending Machine.
scripts.translation:
[蒂蒂库佩]

我爱你
雪人
自动售货机。

scripts.text: ^3355FFToy factory manager Titicupe begins to jump around and emit screams of unbridled ecstacy. At this point, it's not difficult to doubt his sanity, as well as his genius.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF玩具工厂管理员蒂蒂库佩开始手舞足蹈，发出狂喜的尖叫。此时，很难不怀疑他的理智，以及他的天才。

scripts.text:
[Audi]
Hi~ !
I need to tell you one important thing. This vending machine is not equipped to differentiate between special items and ordinary items.
scripts.translation:
[奥迪]
嗨~！
我需要告诉你一件重要的事情。这台自动售货机无法区分特殊物品和普通物品。

scripts.text:
[Audi]
So if you use an item that has been ^FF3355upgraded, or has a card compounded to it^000000, any cards or upgrades will be lost in creating the new item.
scripts.translation:
[奥迪]
所以，如果你使用^FF3355已升级或镶嵌了卡片^000000的物品，在制作新物品时，任何卡片或升级都会丢失。

scripts.text:
[Audi]
So when you try to exchange and generate items, please put all the valuable items you won't be using into the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[奥迪]
因此，当你尝试交换并生成物品时，请把你不会使用的贵重物品放入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Audi]
Please keep this in mind because this Vending Machine does not provide any returns, refunds or exchanges.
scripts.translation:
[奥迪]
请记住这一点，因为这台自动售货机不提供退货、退款或换货服务。

scripts.text:
[Audi]
Have a great time!
Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[奥迪]
祝你玩得开心！
谢谢！
